lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Did they feed you on that plane?
lines.script: [warm, bossy] Did they feed you on that plane?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It was Delta One, Mom. They fed me twice.
lines.script: [proud, easy] It was Delta One, Mom. They fed me twice.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Twice! You must be starving!
lines.script: [alarmed, warm] Twice! You must be starving!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Wait, I have to show you something first. A hill in Los Angeles stood up, talked to us, and sneezed this at me.
lines.script: [excited, telling a wild story] Wait, I have to show you something first. A hill in Los Angeles stood up, talked to us, and sneezed this at me.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: A hill stood up? Out there too? First my kitchen, now California!
lines.script: [alarmed, indignant] A hill stood up? Out there too? First my kitchen, now California!

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: That's gold like my teeth! Cozy Rosie has one, and now you have one. Where's mine?
lines.script: [thrilled, joking] That's gold like my teeth! Cozy Rosie has one, and now you have one. Where's mine?

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: You have to get it from a monster, Boppy.
lines.script: [matter-of-fact, bright] You have to get it from a monster, Boppy.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Then I know just the fish. The Whisker Perch. Whiskers like a cat. I saw him at Cattail Pier in 1994, and he was THIS big.
lines.script: [boastful, delighted] Then I know just the fish. The Whisker Perch. Whiskers like a cat. I saw him at Cattail Pier in 1994, and he was THIS big.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Last time he was only THIS big.
lines.script: [small, teasing] Last time he was only THIS big.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: He grew. It's been thirty years.
lines.script: [defensive, joking] He grew. It's been thirty years.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: We believe you now, Boppy. You were right about the Big One.
lines.script: [warm, sincere] We believe you now, Boppy. You were right about the Big One.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Say that again, slower. Deary, are you hearing this?
lines.script: [delighted, joking] Say that again, slower. Deary, are you hearing this?

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: I heard it. Don't let it go to your head. Your hat won't fit.
lines.script: [dry, sharp, fond] I heard it. Don't let it go to your head. Your hat won't fit.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I believe every fish story you ever told me. I'm bringing the big net.
lines.script: [warm, grinning] I believe every fish story you ever told me. I'm bringing the big net.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Mom, there's one more thing. There was a lemon frozen inside an orange block, just like the dragonfly. And this was lying under it.
lines.script: [serious, careful] Mom, there's one more thing. There was a lemon frozen inside an orange block, just like the dragonfly. And this was lying under it.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Same bulb. One at my pond and one three thousand miles away.
lines.script: [uneasy, quiet] Same bulb. One at my pond and one three thousand miles away.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Two thousand four hundred and seventy-five.
lines.script: [automatic, firm] Two thousand four hundred and seventy-five.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Tom. Not now.
lines.script: [sharp, flat] Tom. Not now.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: I don't know what this is and I don't like it. They're both going in the drawer, and all four of you are coming home in one piece. That's not a request.
lines.script: [firm, worried underneath] I don't know what this is and I don't like it. They're both going in the drawer, and all four of you are coming home in one piece. That's not a request.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: You said next time you were coming.
lines.script: [warm, reminding] You said next time you were coming.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Stomach or no stomach. Let's go fishing!
lines.script: [thrilled, loud] Stomach or no stomach. Let's go fishing!

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: The kettle says there was a big flash over the marsh this morning. Like lightning, but with no thunder and no rain.
lines.script: [gossipy, hushed] The kettle says there was a big flash over the marsh this morning. Like lightning, but with no thunder and no rain.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A flash! The fish at the pond said that. So did the hill!
lines.script: [excited, alarmed] A flash! The fish at the pond said that. So did the hill!

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Lightning over my marsh? If anybody's frying that perch, it's me.
lines.script: [indignant, joking] Lightning over my marsh? If anybody's frying that perch, it's me.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I've got the tackle box in one hand and the big net in the other. I'm ready.
lines.script: [proud, whispering] I've got the tackle box in one hand and the big net in the other. I'm ready.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Those are WHISKERS! That's him! That's the Whisker Perch! Old Iron-Gill himself!
lines.script: [thrilled, shouting] Those are WHISKERS! That's him! That's the Whisker Perch! Old Iron-Gill himself!

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Boppy, he's way bigger than THIS big. He's bigger than the pier!
lines.script: [amazed, shouting] Boppy, he's way bigger than THIS big. He's bigger than the pier!

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: I TOLD everybody he grew!
lines.script: [vindicated, shouting] I TOLD everybody he grew!

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: He TALKS? Thirty years I've been talking to that fish, and NOW he answers?
lines.script: [outraged, delighted] He TALKS? Thirty years I've been talking to that fish, and NOW he answers?

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Boppy, that's what the Big One was like! Now you saw one too!
lines.script: [excited, bouncy] Boppy, that's what the Big One was like! Now you saw one too!

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: I saw one! And Deedee is going to believe me. That's worse. She'll want details.
lines.script: [delighted, then dreading] I saw one! And Deedee is going to believe me. That's worse. She'll want details.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: A talking sock! All my life I've been losing socks, and THIS is where they go?
lines.script: [astonished, indignant] A talking sock! All my life I've been losing socks, and THIS is where they go?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Excuse me, Mr. Sock. We haven't seen your other sock. We're very sorry.
lines.script: [polite, earnest] Excuse me, Mr. Sock. We haven't seen your other sock. We're very sorry.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Boppy, were YOU the one who cast it badly in 1997?
lines.script: [sly, accusing] Boppy, were YOU the one who cast it badly in 1997?

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: It was windy. Write that down. It was very windy.
lines.script: [defensive, joking] It was windy. Write that down. It was very windy.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: The old reeds. I played back in there when I was nine. There's a sundial in a clearing. We called it Sundial Hollow.
lines.script: [nostalgic, warm] The old reeds. I played back in there when I was nine. There's a sundial in a clearing. We called it Sundial Hollow.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: He means please. Could you please shove over?
lines.script: [polite, earnest] He means please. Could you please shove over?

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: That's my boot! I lost that boot in 1988!
lines.script: [astonished, thrilled] That's my boot! I lost that boot in 1988!

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: This is Sundial Hollow. I haven't been back here since I was nine.
lines.script: [quiet, wistful] This is Sundial Hollow. I haven't been back here since I was nine.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: It was green. All of this was green. Who took the green out of my hollow?
lines.script: [hurt, quiet, wondering] It was green. All of this was green. Who took the green out of my hollow?

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Tata! There's a fish in the SKY!
lines.script: [shocked, shrill] Tata! There's a fish in the SKY!

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: It's inside an orange block, like the dragonfly. It's just hanging there. Nothing is holding it up!
lines.script: [amazed, quick] It's inside an orange block, like the dragonfly. It's just hanging there. Nothing is holding it up!

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: That fish jumped, and he never came down. Seventy-some years I've been fishing, and I never saw a fish stay up.
lines.script: [amazed, reverent] That fish jumped, and he never came down. Seventy-some years I've been fishing, and I never saw a fish stay up.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Tom. Get under it with the net.
lines.script: [commanding, serious] Tom. Get under it with the net.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It can't be moved. I tried one at the pond and one in California.
lines.script: [reasonable, uneasy] It can't be moved. I tried one at the pond and one in California.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Then it won't hurt to hold the net.
lines.script: [dry, bossy, grinning] Then it won't hurt to hold the net.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I'm holding the net.
lines.script: [dutiful] I'm holding the net.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Good. Hold it better.
lines.script: [bossy, joking] Good. Hold it better.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: There's a little round hole in the side, like the dragonfly one had. I'm drawing it.
lines.script: [focused, matter-of-fact] There's a little round hole in the side, like the dragonfly one had. I'm drawing it.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: And there's Deedee's litter! On the clock rock!
lines.script: [proud, bright] And there's Deedee's litter! On the clock rock!

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Dragonfly: grey grass, orange block, round hole, burnt bulb. Fish: grey reeds, orange block, round hole, burnt bulb.
lines.script: [reading aloud, precise] Dragonfly: grey grass, orange block, round hole, burnt bulb. Fish: grey reeds, orange block, round hole, burnt bulb.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Lemon: grey tree, orange block, round hole, burnt bulb.
lines.script: [quiet, adding to the list] Lemon: grey tree, orange block, round hole, burnt bulb.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: I'm writing that down too. In pen.
lines.script: [determined, serious] I'm writing that down too. In pen.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Somebody want to tell me what it means?
lines.script: [puzzled, quiet] Somebody want to tell me what it means?

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: I don't know yet, Boppy. I'm only on page two.
lines.script: [honest, small] I don't know yet, Boppy. I'm only on page two.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Well, it's a small one anyway. Mine was double.
lines.script: [boastful, joking] Well, it's a small one anyway. Mine was double.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: That's the Deep Pool. That's where Iron-Gill goes to sulk. Tom, you can put the net down.
lines.script: [alert, then fond] That's the Deep Pool. That's where Iron-Gill goes to sulk. Tom, you can put the net down.

lines.speaker: Old Iron-Gill
lines.text: This morning there was a flash over the hollow. Now I'm big enough to come up and say it to your face.
lines.script: [deep, burbling, hurt] This morning there was a flash over the hollow. Now I'm big enough to come up and say it to your face.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: And he has gold in his mustache!
lines.script: [excited, shrill] And he has gold in his mustache!

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: First the Big One asks about me, and now this one. I'm very big with the fish, Tom.
lines.script: [proud, delighted] First the Big One asks about me, and now this one. I'm very big with the fish, Tom.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: You're a celebrity. I'll hold the net.
lines.script: [warm, joking] You're a celebrity. I'll hold the net.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Tom. Tackle box. We do this the old way.
lines.script: [serious, determined] Tom. Tackle box. We do this the old way.

lines.speaker: Old Iron-Gill
lines.text: And take this. It's been itching my mustache all day.
lines.script: [deep, burbling, gentle] And take this. It's been itching my mustache all day.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Gold like my teeth, with a fish on it! I got one! Cozy Rosie, I got one!
lines.script: [overjoyed, shouting] Gold like my teeth, with a fish on it! I got one! Cozy Rosie, I got one!

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Boppy got treasure! Now your mouth matches your hat!
lines.script: [bouncy, teasing] Boppy got treasure! Now your mouth matches your hat!

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Put the date. Put the time. And put that he was THIS big.
lines.script: [bossy, grinning] Put the date. Put the time. And put that he was THIS big.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Boppy, he was bigger than that.
lines.script: [dry, matter-of-fact] Boppy, he was bigger than that.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: First time in my life I ever undersold a fish.
lines.script: [amazed, joking] First time in my life I ever undersold a fish.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Still up there. Somebody ought to let that fish finish his jump.
lines.script: [quiet, gentle] Still up there. Somebody ought to let that fish finish his jump.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Old Iron-Gill. Forty years, Deary. I TOLD everybody.
lines.script: [proud, shouting] Old Iron-Gill. Forty years, Deary. I TOLD everybody.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: I have proof. It's in my notebook. I drew his mustache.
lines.script: [proud, brisk] I have proof. It's in my notebook. I drew his mustache.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Thank you, Cozy Rosie. Now. Let me look at him.
lines.script: [warm, sharp] Thank you, Cozy Rosie. Now. Let me look at him.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Look. I got gold. From the fish.
lines.script: [proud, hopeful] Look. I got gold. From the fish.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Fifty-one years I've been married to you, hubby, and you never once brought ME gold from a fish.
lines.script: [dry, teasing, fond] Fifty-one years I've been married to you, hubby, and you never once brought ME gold from a fish.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: It's gold like my teeth!
lines.script: [delighted] It's gold like my teeth!

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: I paid for those teeth.
lines.script: [flat, perfect timing] I paid for those teeth.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Deedee, there's another orange block. There's a fish in it, and it's stuck up in the air over the water.
lines.script: [serious, careful] Deedee, there's another orange block. There's a fish in it, and it's stuck up in the air over the water.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: And more litter.
lines.script: [matter-of-fact, bright] And more litter.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Three. My pond, California, and the marsh.
lines.script: [quiet, serious] Three. My pond, California, and the marsh.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: New rule. Nobody in this family goes anywhere alone. Not to the pond, not to the pier, not to the mailbox. Tom, that goes for Los Angeles too.
lines.script: [firm, no nonsense, loving] New rule. Nobody in this family goes anywhere alone. Not to the pond, not to the pier, not to the mailbox. Tom, that goes for Los Angeles too.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yes, Mom.
lines.script: [quiet, obedient] Yes, Mom.
